payload.name: Sommelier's Window
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sommelier's Window helps you decide when to open a bottle. Ask about a specific wine and vintage and get its estimated drinking window, peak years, and current status (for example Hold, Approaching Peak, or At Peak), shown on a simple timeline.

What you can do
- Search the Sommelier's Window database of analyzed wines by name, producer, and vintage.
- Get the drinking window for one wine: optimal years, peak years, how many years remain or until the window opens, a short condition and tasting summary, food pairing ideas, and decanting guidance.
- See a published critic score when one is available, with its source.
- If a wine is not in the database yet, ask for it to be analyzed. The analysis is added as a public page on sommelierswindow.com. New analyses are limited per day.

Good to know
- Drinking windows are estimates for properly stored bottles. Cellar temperature, humidity, light, closure, and bottle variation all affect how a wine ages, so treat the dates as a guide, not a guarantee.
- The status is calculated from the window years and the current year.
- The plugin provides educational wine information only, about how wines age and when they show best. It does not sell wine, process payments, give medical advice, or encourage drinking.
- No account or sign-in is needed, and the plugin cannot see your cellar or any personal data. The privacy policy explains what is processed, including how the daily limit on new analyses is enforced.
payload.longDescription:
Sommelier's Window帮助您决定何时开启一瓶葡萄酒。询问特定葡萄酒及其年份，即可获得其预估适饮期、巅峰年份和当前状态（例如：待饮、接近巅峰或正值巅峰），并以简单的时间线展示。

您可以：
- 通过名称、生产商和年份搜索Sommelier's Window的分析葡萄酒数据库。
- 获取单款葡萄酒的适饮期：最佳年份、巅峰年份、剩余年数或距离适饮期开启的年数、简要状态说明和品鉴摘要、美食搭配建议以及醒酒指导。
- 查看已发布的评分信息（如有），并标注来源。
- 若葡萄酒尚未收录在数据库中，可申请进行分析。

分析结果会以公共页面形式添加至sommelierswindow.com。每日新增分析数量有限。

注意事项
- 适饮期是针对正确储存酒瓶的预估数据。
- 酒窖温度、湿度、光照、封瓶方式和酒瓶差异都会影响葡萄酒的陈年表现，因此日期仅供参考，非保证值。
- 状态信息基于适饮期年份和当前年份计算得出。
- 该插件仅提供关于葡萄酒陈年规律及最佳表现时机的教育性信息。
- 本插件不销售葡萄酒、处理支付、提供医疗建议或鼓励饮酒。
- 无需账户或登录，插件无法访问您的酒窖或任何个人数据。
- 隐私政策说明了处理的数据内容，包括每日新增分析数量限制的执行方式。

payload.name: RegAI Legal (Taiwan)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RegAI Legal gives ChatGPT grounded access to Taiwan's laws and court decisions, so answers cite the actual statute or ruling.

Search statutes by concept or keyword, fetch an article by number (with the official English translation where one exists), browse a law's structure or read its full text, look up a decision by its citation, search apex-court decisions by concept or fact pattern, list every decision containing an exact phrase with the exact total, and search Grand Chamber (大法庭) rulings that resolve divergent legal interpretations.

Data: Taiwan's Ministry of Justice national law database (全國法規資料庫), including each law's effective status and pending amendments, and an apex-tier subset of Judicial Yuan decisions (Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, Constitutional Court, Disciplinary Court, Intellectual Property and Commercial Court, plus Grand Chamber rulings). District and high court decisions are not included.

All tools are read-only and query only public legal data. Queries and law names are Traditional Chinese; ask in English and ChatGPT translates for you. Sign in with a RegAI account (email code or LINE). Results are for research and are not legal advice.

payload.name: LSAT Unplugged
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Ask this connector what a law school's class scored and you get the 25th, median, and 75th percentile LSAT and GPA, for 196 schools, with the source next to each number. Ask what the school costs and you get its ABA 509 numbers: acceptance rate, tuition, the share of students who got a grant, the median grant, and the first-time bar passage rate, each with the year it was filed. Give it your LSAT score and it lists the schools where that score sits at or above the 75th percentile, the median, or the 25th percentile.

Ask when the next LSAT is and you get the next 3 test dates, the registration deadline for each, and the day scores come out, all checked against LSAC. Ask what's on the test and you get the current format. Logic Games came off the LSAT in August 2024, and prep books written before then still teach it.

You can also ask if there's a free explanation for a specific LSAT question. If there is, you get the answer, a short version of our reasoning, and the link to the full walkthrough. If there isn't, you get the closest ones that exist. For practice, it links a free drill by question type or Reading Comprehension passage topic.

Ask about our prep and it'll tell you what each package includes and which one fits your test date and your score gap.

I'm Steve Schwartz. I've been coaching the LSAT since 2005, and LSAT Unplugged is me plus a team of coaches.

It won't guess your admission odds, register you for the test, quote our prices, sell you anything inside the chat, or show LSAT question text.

payload.name: Recherche Externe
payload.description: 引用真实的网络和法律来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recherche Externe is a research and verification toolkit with real internet access for AI agents. Its golden rule is to never answer from memory: every fact, article or figure it asserts should come from a page actually fetched, with the excerpt and the URL cited. It does six things. (1) chercher_web runs a keyless, best-effort general web search, trying Bing then DuckDuckGo (often rate-limited from a server) and falling back to the Wikipedia search API; it returns titles, URLs and snippets to locate sources and reports which engine was used, without claiming to know the page contents. (2) lire_page fetches a URL and returns its readable text (title and content) live, for the general web, LegisQuebec, Justice Canada and PDF files, whose text is extracted page by page; it does not execute JavaScript, so purely dynamic or bot-protected pages may fail. (3) loi_quebec fetches the exact official text of a Quebec statute or regulation article from LegisQuebec and returns it with its URL. (4) loi_federale fetches federal statute text from laws-lois.justice.gc.ca (for example the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act). (5) chercher_jurisprudence builds reliable CanLII and SOQUIJ case-law search links to open in a browser: because CanLII blocks automated server-side fetching, this tool does not claim to read decisions, it only provides links. (6) sources_officielles_qc returns verified links and the matching tool to use for official Quebec sources by theme (case law, statutes and regulations, professional orders, land and real-estate records). Recherche Externe is read-oriented: it only searches and reads public sources, needs no account, and never modifies, sends, deploys or acts in any external system. When a source is unreachable it says so ("not verified - source unreachable") instead of filling the gap with a plausible reconstruction, and it marks any text longer than the requested limit as truncated rather than presenting it as complete.
payload.longDescription:
Recherche Externe 是一个研究与验证工具包，为 AI 代理提供真实的互联网访问权限。其核心原则是永远不要仅凭记忆作答：所有它声称的事实、文章或数据都必须来自实际获取的页面，并附上摘录和网址引用。
它具备六大功能。 (1) 网络搜索会执行无密钥、尽力而为的通用网络搜索，优先尝试必应，再尝试 DuckDuckGo（通常受服务器速率限制），最后使用维基百科搜索 API；它会返回标题、网址和摘要以定位来源，并说明使用了哪个搜索引擎，但不会声称了解页面内容。 (2) 获取页面会获取网址并实时返回可读文本（标题和内容），适用于普通网络、魁北克立法网站（LegisQuebec）、加拿大司法部网站（Justice Canada）和 PDF 文件（逐页提取文本）；它不执行 JavaScript，因此纯动态或机器人保护的页面可能无法加载。 (3) 魁北克法律会从 LegisQuebec 获取魁北克法规或条例的官方原文并附上网址。 (4) 联邦法律会从 laws-lois.justice.gc.ca 获取联邦法规文本（例如《破产与清算法》）。 (5) 法律判例会构建可靠的加拿大判例法搜索链接（CanLII 和 SOQUIJ），可在浏览器中打开：由于 CanLII 禁止服务器端自动获取，此工具不声称能阅读判决书，仅提供链接。 (6) 魁北克官方来源会按主题（判例法、法规、专业机构、土地和房地产记录）返回验证过的链接及对应工具。
Recherche Externe 以阅读为主：它仅搜索和阅读公开来源，无需账户，且从不修改、发送、部署或在任何外部系统中执行操作。当来源无法访问时，它会明确说明（“未验证 - 来源不可达”），而非用合理但虚构的内容填补空白，并会将超过请求限制的文本标记为已截断，而非显示为完整内容。

Give a birth date, place and (ideally) time, and it computes the natal chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: the sign, degree and house of every planet, the North Node and Chiron, the Ascendant and Midheaven, the twelve house cusps (Koch, Placidus or Whole Sign) and the major aspects with their exact orbs. It also lists the tight transits of any day to your chart (only aspects really within orb), shows the sky of a day — Moon sign and phase, lunations, sign changes, retrograde stations and exact aspects — and finds knowledge-base pages for a placement, aspect, house, pattern or transit.

Vedic (Jyotish) basics: the sidereal chart (Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses from the Lagna) with the rashi, house, nakshatra and pada of every graha, and the Vimshottari dasha periods with dates. Pure calculation in a kind tone: no dosha labels, no predictions.

In ChatGPT the chart is drawn as a wheel with planets, houses, aspect lines and today's transits; the Vedic chart as a South-Indian square chart with a dasha timeline.

Privacy: no account is needed and nothing is stored — birth data is used only for the calculation and is not logged. Astrology here is for self-reflection, not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. Works in English and Russian.

它还会列出任意日期与您本命盘的紧密相位（仅显示真正处于相位范围内的相位），展示某一天的天象——包括月相与月相变化、黄道星座转换、逆行转折点及精确相位，并能为特定星体位置、相位、宫位、星象格局或行运找到对应的知识库页面。

吠陀占星（Jyotish）基础功能：黄道坐标系盘（采用Lahiri岁差值，以命宫为基准的全星座宫位），显示每个行星的黄道十二宫（Rashi）、宫位、纳沙特拉（Nakshatra）及帕达（Pada），以及维姆绍特里（Vimshottari）命主周期及其日期。纯数学计算，语气中立：不标注体液（Dosha）类型，不提供预测。

在ChatGPT中，占星盘以行星、宫位、相位线和今日行运的轮盘图呈现；吠陀占星盘则以南印度方形图形式展示，并附命主周期时间轴。

隐私政策：无需账户且不存储任何数据——出生信息仅用于计算且不会被记录。此处的占星术仅用于自我反思，不构成医疗、心理、法律或财务建议。支持英语和俄语。
